nodes.start.options.[spisz].text.t: I'll write down everyone you remember and take it to the church.

nodes.start.options.[sprzedaj].text.t: I'll take the list. I know people who pay for that kind of information.

nodes.start.options.[zataj].text.t: Better not to write them down. A name leaves a trail, and a trail leads to the living.

nodes.start.text.t: The gravedigger leans his shovel against the fence and looks over the rows of unmarked mounds. "Mister, half the town lies here and nobody knows who. I remember maybe twenty, but the rest? The rest is winter and typhus. Somebody should write them down, on paper, on stone. But stone costs, and paper has a worse memory than I do."

nodes.wynik_spisz.text.t: The gravedigger dictates, you write. Names, nicknames, places. Thirty-eight names, then another forty-one. You finish at dusk, in silence. The gravedigger ties up the sack of slips and hands it to you with respect.

nodes.wynik_sprzedaj.text.t: The gravedigger looks at you as at a man who has just renounced something important. "You sell the dead?" But the list is already in your hand.

nodes.wynik_zataj.text.t: The gravedigger is quiet for a long while, then nods. "You're right. Some names are better made into silence." He covers the mounds with another layer of earth.
